commands.stdout:
Extract one function (plus reachable subprograms) from a userspace x86-64 ELF and rewrite it for native_lab.

Usage: native-link [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT> --symbol <SYMBOL> --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --input <INPUT>
          Input ELF object/shared library (e.g. *.native.so from micro/programs)
      --symbol <SYMBOL>
          Symbol name of the entry function to extract
      --output <OUTPUT>
          Output path for the raw native blob bytes
      --output-relocs <OUTPUT_RELOCS>
          Output path for the side-band relocations table consumed by the kernel module at splat time. Omit if the input has no external helper or map references
      --output-map-patches <OUTPUT_MAP_PATCHES>
          Output path for map literal patch sites. Each line is NAME<TAB>OFFSET, where OFFSET points at an 8-byte literal-pool slot that the runner must fill with the current kernel map pointer
      --output-abi <OUTPUT_ABI>
          Output path for native_lab ABI sideband metadata consumed by the runner
      --link-plan <LINK_PLAN>
          Versioned structured link plan containing helper/map/callsite facts. This is the stable loader/native-link boundary for kernel mode
      --show
          Print a human-readable disassembly of the rewritten blob to stderr
      --preserve-entry-abi
          Keep the compiler's entry-function saves in the verifier's proof input
      --mode <MODE>
          Link mode. `proof` applies canonical ABI/link edits but leaves verifier-after helper/map lowering symbolic and emits a relocatable proof object for the eBPF simulator generator [default: kernel] [possible values: kernel, proof]
  -h, --help
          Print help
